title: Arcadia
tagline: Arcadia is a native mobile app to create live streams to get AI agents to bet on them
description:
The frontend is an iOS application, a user account is managed using an embedded wallet and a JWT token. 

On the backend, there are multiple services running: 
1) upload live stream and store the video on 0G storage
2) Video analysis on the stream (MachineFi)
3) Chainlink orchestration managing creation of bets and resolving the bets based on the MachineFi hook.
how_its_made:
The frontend is built using Swift. It uses Dynamic embedded wallet SDK
The chain in use is 0G. 
The storage is 0G storage
The video analysis API is iotex's MachineFi, which takes a trigger condition to settle the bet
The orchestration layer is Chainlink's CRE to manage creation of bets as well as their resolution.
auto_summary: An iOS app and supporting backend let users start livestream-based prediction bets, analyze streams, and resolve markets via external services and on-chain actions.
